[EN] Aaaaagh! We're all going to die!
[ES] ¡Aaaaagh! ¡Vamos a morir todos!

[EN] The dragons are coming back.
[ES] Los dragones están regresando.

[EN] Ugh... you're the... I have something to tell you...
[ES] Ugh... eres el... Tengo algo que decirte...

[EN] The siege has begun. It's every man for himself!
[ES] El asedio ha comenzado. ¡Sálvese quien pueda!

[EN] It looks like a survivor. Hurry, before it's too late.
[ES] Parece un sobreviviente. Date prisa, antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

[EN] Seir is gathering what is left of the guards.
[ES] Seir está reuniendo lo que queda de los guardias.

[EN] The ground trembles...
[ES] El suelo tiembla...

[EN] They stopped attacking.
[ES] Detuvieron el ataque.

[EN] This... is too much...
[ES] Esto... es demasiado...

[EN] I can hear the dragons coming back!
[ES] ¡Puedo oír que los dragones regresan!

[EN] Ugh... over here...
[ES] Ugh... por aquí...

[EN] It's the man you saw at the entrance. He's trapped, and dying.
[ES] Es el hombre que viste en la entrada. Está atrapado y muriendo.

[EN] I won't make it. Go... you're our only hope...
[ES] No lo lograré. Ve... eres nuestra única esperanza...
